system.description:
Imbues an item with power aligned to a task, practice or philosophy: a temporary Telesma or permanent Regalia that often becomes a house or order's sacred relic.

Spell. Investiture of Telesma: Challenging (9) for +1 to test totals, Hard (15) for +1B or a quality, Heroic (21) for +1D or a Benefit. Ten minutes of chanting. Grants +1 to one ability's tests toward the declared purpose for a week; extra degrees add +1 or another week. Failure ruins the item.

Ritual. Alignment: Challenging (9) Knowledge, 1 hour cleansing the space and item. Invocation: Persuasion, 3 hours, Difficulty by bonus as for Telesma. Failure ends the rite harmlessly. Unleashing: Hard (15) Will. Success permanently invests the item (Investiture of Regalia) and each degree makes it harder to break; failure destroys the item and wounds the sorcerer.

Art of Benediction — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 94.
system.resonances: An unbroken item of good quality (spell); an item worth 100+ gold plus 2 gold of consumables (ritual).
